title: Editor browser and ordinary-DML finish criteria
body:
# Focused development finish recommendation — October 3, 2026

Director receiving run: `0cee3641-133d-440a-85b3-410a6e0ce662`.

**Recommend Codex publish the final reviewed evidence and merge PR #4 after the two focused checks below pass and Test independently disposes their actual results.** Product candidate remains `aead8ff52128859fbae8b0f3d8ed2de67aff5131`, tree `5880845c045af75e19c686cb5840b736a414abfa`. No demonstrated blocking product defect remains in the received evidence; the final editor browser and ordinary-DML protection checks are pending. This is development merge readiness, not a claim that all original H01–H20 or independent institutional acceptance passed.

## Evidence and authority

- [Founder delivery direction, October 3, 20:42 UTC](/MAU/issues/MAU-140#comment-3cfa7b9b-5c25-4d5b-95e8-1fcce35147a4) authorizes Codex publication/merge after satisfactory focused tests and Director review. No additional generic merge approval is needed.
- [Source review](/MAU/issues/MAU-144#document-director-review-968c2634): affected-source PASS; F1 closed; R1/R2 closed at their recorded source scope. Reuse passing suites.
- [Installed-release review](/MAU/issues/MAU-140#document-installed-release-review-3b870ca3): exact candidate/image installed; auth preserved; existing database reused. No repeat deployment/reset.
- [Actual editor-only HTTP execution](/MAU/issues/MAU-140#comment-abeb2a5a-5f84-4cbc-a435-fb041e492d78): exit 0, 29 PASS assertion entries, two Viewer omissions, 17 requests. Replay/conflict/stale revision/no-change/validation/pinned history passed. [Published independent Test report](/api/attachments/bd880b2f-805c-4686-add2-9aa9b04c5053/content?download=1), SHA-256 `aabe95883a2c01c4b75e9029d02acd98a54dc85855fddf5f0d32ae09e5029433`, runs `cee6b6e9-7f52-4881-89e0-447a01c6f628` and `bfa169c5-48d7-4034-b3bb-3e3971cb930e`, independently reconciles these actual results. Test's original independent disposition remains unchanged.
- Separately hashed actual row-binding addendum `50fb4b72779adbf0a110078c628d589a498c0993168e6d603fca7e4d32e572da`: 8/8 observed checks; Test independently recomputed the bindings. Four identity rows are two stable relationship identities plus two separate impact identities. The preparation omission is corrected explicitly; **no product defect or pending binding read remains**.
- [Viewer waiver](/MAU/issues/MAU-140#document-scope-amendment-viewer-waiver): all remaining Viewer checks WAIVED BY FOUNDER / NOT EXECUTED, excluded from delivery blockers. Historical 401s and original reports remain intact.
- [Exact contract](/MAU/issues/MAU-140#document-contract), revision `3982eccc-e180-4ac9-bc70-9c4e16aa47f1`, SHA-256 `f9a7ebe54e329d1a994b7f37e5fd5bc62413c215e0f58acae1c8c7d4f604b0c9`, sections 6/12 and H14; source migrations `0002_source_invariants.py` and `0005_hypothesis_history_guards.py` at the exact candidate. CEO brief Final Version 1.0, September 17, supplies research/independent-assurance boundaries; later recorded founder directions govern this development delivery.

## Two final checks, owned by existing Test

1. **One editor browser flow.** Home → exact fixture Idea → Create Hypothesis using its existing Research case/family context. Save one invented minimal draft; refresh, return through normal navigation and reopen the same identity. Revise to v2 with distinct rule markers, valid effect/holding durations, intended benchmark/rationale and correction reason. Verify values survive reopening, synthetic/draft semantics remain, missing fields resolve as intended, and the exact v1/history/context links retain pinned versions. Submit one invalid revision with a negative duration and safely escaped hostile-looking text; verify error focus/summary, input retention and no new saved version. Follow Source/Idea/family/case links and return. Record exact candidate, real editor principal, row/version IDs, statuses, sanitized screenshots and API parity. No concurrent browser edits during the actual bounded mutation interval; do not reuse the released HTTP window. Test authors the flow; sole executor Codex returns actual evidence; Test evaluates it independently.
2. **One rollback-only protection batch.** The [operator's exact supplied probe](/MAU/issues/MAU-140#document-history-guard-probe-review), SHA `923f08ea3789876f8f5cf39fe39c2035a2c92c67448bf4075f836e6744d419c4`, is accepted for Codex execution; do not implement a duplicate. It uses the deployed Django connection, checks target/build/migrations/users/role attributes, matches synthetic rows across all 12 Increment-2 guarded tables, and requires trigger-specific UPDATE/DELETE rejections in rolled-back savepoints and an unconditionally rolled-back outer transaction. It uses bounded transaction-local timeouts and no DDL, inserts, commits, truncate, role/grant/replication/trigger/auth changes. Empty tables remain NOT EXECUTED. Sample fingerprints include immutable content; identity fingerprints exclude allowed derived watermarks, so they are not a pointer equality assertion or complete DB audit. Reuse actual auth/count evidence; verify allowed pointer advancement in the browser flow. Test independently reviews actual output/coverage, with core Hypothesis/version/association/impact rows present. Any unexpectedly successful DML is a blocking defect despite rollback.

The browser facility is the already-used Playwright 1.56.1 procedure in `staging/browser/HEADLESS.md`. Codex now observes the existing package, restored same approved image digest `f1e7e01021efd65dd1a2c56064be399f3e4de00fd021ac561325f2bfbb2b837a`, and successful non-root/read-only/cap-drop/no-new-privileges Chromium/private-TLS preflight; no environment work remains. The old Source/Idea script is an execution pattern, not the Hypothesis acceptance flow. Existing approved authentication handling stays unchanged; no passwords in arguments, logs, artifacts or prompts. Test provides exact browser script hashes, command, target and write budget for one bounded Director review before dispatch.

## H14 technical disposition

**Yes: ordinary UPDATE/DELETE probes through the actual deployed application binding can verify the ordinary-DML trigger behavior without a new role.** Section 6 excludes privileged-administrator protection; H14 offers ordinary API OR application database role. The account `rms_staging` is privileged and must remain described that way. A privileged account executing normal DML with guards enabled still encounters these row triggers; this observation cannot demonstrate that it lacks the ability to bypass/remove them.

For immutable rows, the exact source raises SQLSTATE `23000` through `rms_reject_row_change`; identity direct UPDATE/DELETE raises `P0001` through `rms_hn_guard_identity`. Require the matching trigger diagnostic, not an unrelated foreign-key, read-only, permission or missing-row error. A matched no-op UPDATE exercises the unconditional BEFORE UPDATE guard; DELETE exercises the retention guard. Successful browser append also checks the allowed derived-pointer path. Least-privilege hardening, administrator tamper resistance and independent custody are explicitly deferred limitations; do not label this account an ordinary low-privilege role or relabel the observer as an H14 pass. Test independently records the resulting scoped verdict and any dissent. A new ordinary-role decision is not a prerequisite for this bounded test.

## Blocking defects and explicit deferrals

Block merge for an actual wrong pin/identity, overwritten historical content, inconsistent v1/v2 field persistence, save-on-error, unsafe input rendering, or successful prohibited ordinary DML. If either focused check fails, preserve exact evidence and correct/retest only the affected behavior before review. No such product defect is established by the current HTTP/row evidence.

Full DB transaction/session overlap remains INCONCLUSIVE: 716 sampler attempts observed zero simultaneous assigned-XID pairs. Client overlap plus serialization is not a proven DB-overlap PASS, and missing samples are not a demonstrated race. Defer deeper PID/lock-wait correlation and broad concurrency permutations. Also explicitly defer the broader context-create/correction, duration/reference-boundary, pagination/accessibility/viewport, Source/Idea regression, complete fixture recovery and other unexecuted matrix permutations. Keep Test's original case map, failures and independent dissent unchanged; final report enumerates what the focused flow actually exercised. These are limitations of the proposed development merge, not retroactive H passes. Full institutional acceptance, Risk/Stage 1, 34 unexecuted Stage 1 cases and restricted incident remain separate. No research-cycle/qualification credit.

## Finish and handoff

Next action: Codex executes the accepted exact operator guard probe once. Test on [MAU-144](/MAU/issues/MAU-144), active receiving run `fe17d661-748a-4756-9a65-99d450b343dd`, implements the already founder-assigned single browser flow and independently evaluates both actual results; no duplicate probe authoring. Its actual-result/row reconciliation is now published. Director reviews exact browser command/hash/bindings/writes once; Codex executes once using existing resources; Test reports actual outcomes and scoped dissent; Director records the risk-based verdict. If satisfactory, Codex publishes approved test/evidence changes and merges [PR #4](https://github.com/dieg0andres/mv-rms/pull/4) into master under the recorded founder direction. Record exact final PR head, any evidence-only successor/tree, merge commit and master readback. Product changes require affected retest; an evidence-only successor must disclose that the deployed/tested product remains aead8ff and verify application paths unchanged. No blanket staging or environment work follows from merge.

Alternative: keep the draft PR pending additional matrix coverage. Recommendation prefers the two high-value checks and an honest development merge limitation record, reflecting the founder's explicit delivery direction. T0/dates/capacity are not invented. Acceptance of this recommendation does not waive independent Research/Risk standards or authorize the next increment.

title: Exact browser executable accepted; stale-key contract disposition
body:
# Browser receiving review — ACCEPTED for one bounded execution

Director run `cafd49a9-0b3c-44a4-9ea5-0fbb36b922bc`, October 3, 2026. Product `aead8ff52128859fbae8b0f3d8ed2de67aff5131`, tree `5880845c045af75e19c686cb5840b736a414abfa`.

**Accept Test's unchanged exact browser executable for ONE Codex execution through the existing facility.** [Package](/api/attachments/0216ad2b-7c6a-4bb4-a4fc-920da878857a/content?download=1) ZIP SHA `ceaa6d7965fa3d4fd9c5cf87dddadb87c5d2e462b57d545096bfe58ffbadd288`; script SHA `de61910ae49f207467b057fd8d13208ab35f3b0a30c3c0a1687f249aeb789be5`. Authenticated download/hash matched; all 25 manifest lengths/hashes match; embedded reviewed application blobs and origin helper match the exact Git candidate. Test reports Node syntax/8 focused offline methods/29 schema-field checks PASS; Director reused those results and performed receiving file/source review only, with no suite/browser/database execution.

Exact in-container command:

```sh
node /work/tests/browser/hypothesis_editor_smoke.mjs --run --run-id "$RMS_BROWSER_RUN_ID" --output "/results/hypothesis-editor-$RMS_BROWSER_RUN_ID"
```

Use the already observed official image digest `f1e7e01021efd65dd1a2c56064be399f3e4de00fd021ac561325f2bfbb2b837a`, existing Playwright 1.56.1 package tree mounted read-only, actual in-container `RMS_PLAYWRIGHT_PACKAGE_ROOT`, fixed existing `/run/secrets/test_editor_password` read-only mount and existing private origin whose digest the script checks. Fresh actual UUID and absent output child are required. Codex records real argv/runtime/module/image/source identities and UTC interval. No installation, role/credential change, new service or reopened old HTTP reservation.

Reviewed bounds: HTTPS/same-origin validation before module/secret access; pinned package version; TLS verification; read-only API calls with redirects disabled; cross-origin/unplanned writes blocked; exactly five native POST attempts restricted to create and the one owned Hypothesis revision route. One unique invented Hypothesis, v1/v2/v3, two stable edge identities/six edge versions, three successful receipts and source-required initial impacts/identities. No parent/context mutations, global-count assumptions, viewer work, automatic retry or cleanup. Preserve all committed additions and actual failures. Summary contains whitelisted invented fields/IDs/statuses/digests; no raw auth/origin/HAR/trace/cookies. Narrow screenshots target owned synthetic content. Unexpected transport/status failure aborts without retry; known stale denial can continue independent read/error slices while retaining a failure.

## Stale-key assertion: contract-based product disposition

**A fresh transport key after a confirmed stale rejection is not, by itself, a demonstrated product defect.** Exact [contract](/MAU/issues/MAU-140#document-contract), revision `3982eccc-e180-4ac9-bc70-9c4e16aa47f1`, SHA `f9a7ebe54e329d1a994b7f37e5fd5bc62413c215e0f58acae1c8c7d4f604b0c9`, section 8/H11 requires the losing unsaved snapshot to survive, a latest-record comparison path and no silent overwrite. Sections 6/7/H10 require same-key identical-content replay and changed-content conflict. They do not require the browser to reuse its hidden transport key after a confirmed rejected stale attempt.

Exact source `check_expected` raises `StaleVersion` before the revision appends; `execute_write` creates the idempotency result after the operation succeeds inside the same atomic transaction. A stale exception rolls back; it is not an accepted-but-unknown save. The 409 browser branch passes the submitted snapshot unchanged into `render_form`, which supplies a fresh key. The unchanged expected-version field still prevents overwrite. Unknown database/503 outcomes explicitly preserve the submitted original key for unchanged replay; that distinct requirement is not waived. This finding addresses the checker's known two-tab stale case, not a blanket endorsement of every possible 409 or unknown-outcome path.

Test's `stale_full_input_and_original_key_preserved` compares slash-prefixed owned controls AND `idempotency_key`; source predicts an idempotency-only difference. **Keep the original assertion, raw FAIL/nonzero outcome if observed, evidence and independent dissent unchanged.** This execution acceptance does not edit Test code or predeclare a raw green run. Test independently reports whether the only changed path is that hidden key, the scientific/context/reason/expected-version snapshot remains unchanged, the response is the intended stale denial and history stays exactly v1/v2/v3. Director records an attributed contract disposition separately; do not relabel the raw failed assertion PASS. Any other lost input, unintended version/save, wrong pin or overwritten history remains a blocking product defect. No product change/redeployment is justified solely by the predicted key difference.

## Completed protection gate and remaining decision

Received the [independent guard result](/MAU/issues/MAU-140#comment-b8d665a7-5eec-4ace-8b35-aa7808ca62bc): SCOPED PASS, 22 exact UPDATE/DELETE denials on 11 populated tables; external-reference table empty/NOT EXECUTED. Result SHA `6da5772002f89691ed3ea823cc020286f3c3bf7b95c4171679d4970a8e343748`; independent bundle SHA `58923f1c034bb1813bdc76f1fd1cd76b851e171961e2553871844c621cee6638` both match. Actual privileged binding remains privileged; no whole-DB/auth/pointer equality, administrator bypass, TRUNCATE or least-privilege claim. Earlier launcher SyntaxError and omitted `-B` are preserved as reported. No repeat probe.

Next: Codex performs the accepted browser run once; Test independently evaluates actual contract behavior and original extra key assertion on existing [MAU-144](/MAU/issues/MAU-144); Director receives the results and records the named-commit development merge recommendation. Merge remains conditional on actual required behavior and review under the already recorded founder direction. Viewer checks remain waived; deeper DB overlap and broad matrix permutations stay incomplete/deferred, not passed. Full original H01–H20, Stage 1, Risk and research qualification remain separate. No current actual browser result is claimed.

Local HEAD matches; tracked/index status shows no modifications, with preserved untracked prior work/evidence. On missing evidence: identify a smallest executable case or exact separate access decision. No repeated full-suite/source prep or new broad planning task.

Keep all non-waived criteria and section-12 review/merge/staging/founder-browser obligations. This scope decision is not research/Risk qualification, execution permission, SQL access or strategy-testing approval. This root performed instruction/control-plane/Git read-only checks and document coordination only; no live binding check, password handling, test, reset/deployment or source modification.
